text: Looking for space and timeless character? This charming Victorian offers room to grow with 6 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and two full kitchens, making it ideal for multi-generational living or potential conversion to a two-family investment property. Situated on 3/4 of an acre and just a short walk to downtown, the home blends convenience with classic architectural beauty. Step inside to discover stunning original woodwork, a graceful winding staircase, and the distinctive craftsmanship that defines Victorian design. The first-floor primary suite, complete with handicap accessibility and a separate entrance, provides excellent flexibility for private living quarters or guest accommodations. The main level also features an additional bedroom and full bath, while the upper level offers four bedrooms and another full bath, plus a walk-up attic providing excellent storage or future finishing potential. Recent updates include 18 new windows (2022), new oil tank (2022), new insulation in attic and walls (2023), and a garage roof replaced in 2024. With a two-car garage, generous living space, and endless possibilities, this gentle fixer-upper is ready for your vision to restore and enhance its already abundant charm. Gorgeous home, exceptional space, and endless potential--schedule your showing today.

Energy-efficient windows, modern updates, and thoughtful design touches make this home move-in ready. This property truly combines style, comfort, and luxury in one exceptional package.

Tucked away on 7 peaceful acres, this private retreat offers the perfect balance of nature, space, and convenience. A year-round creek winds through the property, creating a serene setting surrounded by mature trees and the quiet beauty of the outdoors. The home features 4 bedrooms plus a versatile bonus space-ideal for a home office, creative studio, or even a home-based business. Inside, you'll find fresh new carpet and interior paint, giving the home a clean and welcoming feel. The kitchen includes a center island, all appliances, and a window overlooking the woods, bringing natural light and tranquil views into the heart of the home. Step outside onto the expansive deck and take in the peaceful scenery-an ideal spot for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or simply enjoying the privacy and sounds of the creek below. The property also includes a 24x30 shop, perfect for hobbies, projects, storage, or extra workspace. This is truly a retreat-like setting-a place to escape, unwind, and enjoy the beauty of nature, while still being close to town with easy freeway access for everyday convenience.
